author: Luke Larson
title: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Siouxland faces shortage of male mentors - NewsBreak
text:
By Luke Larson Maren Ewertz ,
1 days ago
SIOUX CITY , Iowa ( KCAU ) — When organizers from Big Brothers Big Sisters (BBBS) of Siouxland aren’t organizing events for their members, they’re busy searching for something else: male mentors.
“We are in desperate need of male Bigs,” said Ciarra Prather, the Executive Director of BBBS of Siouxland.
Bigs and Littles from across Siouxland came together this Earth Day to clean up litter in Kelly Park, a way to give back to the community.
But what you wouldn’t see if you were at that event today was a laundry list of boys sitting on a waiting list.
“We have these little guys that have been on our waiting lists for some time. I mean, one has even been up there for almost two years. So we are looking for males to step forward and volunteer. It’s a lot of fun, and you’ll find out in the end that it’s actually more rewarding for you than it is probably the little,” said Prather.
Story continues below
With a time commitment of just four hours a month, one male Big shared his story and said he suggests Siouxland men step up.
“We’ve been together for about two and a half years,” said Brad Reynders, Big Brother of Lyriq. “I looked forward to doing something when my boys graduated from high school and wanted to give back to the community. They do a great job of matching people up. I think that men should get a chance to look at this and give it a whirl, ask some questions, or at least do an interview and see what it’s like.”
If you’re interested in learning more information or becoming a Big, you can find that information and apply on their website .
